# Rats Collective

> Finland-registered marketing agency specializing in TikTok music marketing and sound promotion.

## Services
- TikTok sound promotion campaigns for artists, labels and music teams.
- Campaign distribution through a network of approximately 20 accounts.
- Social media page management for owned and third-party pages.
- Conversations about potential artist management partnerships.
